Title: Public Preview: Managed Java component (Admin for Spring) in Azure Container Apps

Body.Content:
You can use managed Java components to access platform features for your apps that you would otherwise have to manage yourself. Azure Container Apps now offers managed Admin for Spring to monitor and configure Spring Boot web applications. This component is based on the Spring Boot Admin community project and currently available in public preview.

Learn more.
